v0.5.4.description:
## Install

Download `TFT-Archipelago-Setup-0.5.4.exe` below and run it. It installs for your Windows user only, without admin rights. The installer is not signed yet: if Windows SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC", click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

Already installed? The app updates itself. The update installs when you close the app, or right away with **Restart** at the bottom of the sidebar.

## Multiworld Files

- `tft_archipelago.apworld`: the APWorld for whoever generates the multiworld. Double-click it to install it into Archipelago 0.6.5 or newer.
- `TFT-Archipelago-template.yaml`: the player options template. The app's **Setup** page also creates a YAML for you.

v0.5.7.description:
## What's New

### Trust Mode
- New player option `trust_mode`: the app does not check your restrictions, so a match is never invalidated. You keep track of your limits yourself, and the blockers stay as reminders.
- Choose it in the new **Rule checking** step of the **Setup** walkthrough. Overview and sidebar show "Trust mode" while it is active.
- Needs the new APWorld (0.5.0) and a newly generated multiworld. Existing seeds keep the normal checks.
- Detection works best with the game client set to English. If false positives keep coming on another language, Trust Mode is the way out.

### Fewer false XP purchases
- Two quick shop rerolls or two quick champion purchases no longer count as an XP purchase.
- The app now reads more digits of the XP counter (0-6 and 8). When it can read the counter and the XP did not go up, a 4 gold drop is not counted as an XP purchase.
